Duplexes and half duplexes in Tsawwassen
What a duplex looks like in Tsawwassen

items.t: The usual duplex form: Individual duplex buildings on single lots in Delta's designated zones, selling whole (building + lot, one title) unless a parcel was strata-divided into a 2-lot plan or subdivided fee-simple. No individual parcel in either divided form is verified or named here.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Tsawwassen

items.t: Flood / hazard DPA SD3: Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands) in Bylaw 8400 provides: No habitable floor below 2.9 m GSC datum, minimum land surface elevation around construction 2.3 m GSC datum, and no building within 7.5 m of the natural boundary of a tidal area. Whether a specific lot falls inside SD3: Not verified — requires a DeltaMap check for that lot. First-round diligence on any Beach Grove / Boundary Beach duplex.

faq.q: What flood diligence applies near Boundary Bay?
faq.a: Check DPA SD3 for the parcel: 2.9 m GSC habitable-floor level, 2.3 m minimum land elevation, 7.5 m tidal setback. Parcel inclusion requires a DeltaMap check.

faq.q: When are Delta property taxes due?
faq.a: July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding balances after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 2, 2026 — the City of Delta calendar, which does not by itself state TFN leasehold tax treatment in Tsawwassen North.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
